comments:
These games are my absolute top 20. Every single one is a 10/10 masterpiece. What makes a game great for me is valued firstly how impactful it has been for me. Most of the time the impactfulness is valued by how good the story is and what the game means for me. The general public often values a masterpiece how every element in a game is great/perfect. So for me the gameplay always doesn't need to be perfect if the story carries the impactful value. Also besides the story I value a good soundtrack a lot.

Anyways please play at least one of these games before your time is up. Video games are the greatest form of entertainment and storytelling.

games.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.description: The greatest video game ever created. Story, gameplay, visual, music, EVERYTHING perfection. You will laugh you will cry you will love this game whoever you are. Be like me and give games that aren't really your thing a try some time ok? Best decision I've ever made.

games.title: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number (Also Hotline Miami 1)
games.description: A controversial choice. This game changed my music taste and understanding of video game violence. I wouldn't be myself right now if this game didn't hit my radar back in 2022.

games.title: Sea of Stars
games.description: Introduced me to turn based RPGs. A lovely journey and a experience created with pure passion for these types of games. Sabotage Studios has to be my favorite game studio. The first playthrough really carries here. You only get to experience it once so make it memorable.

games.title: Elden Ring
games.description: Closest thing to a perfect video game. So many ways to play this masterpiece. The freedom to choose your own build and adventure just feels incredible. Also the DLC may be the best DLC ever created. Only negative for me with this game is the replay value and the base game soundtrack. They just aren't at the same level with the other soulsborne games for me.

games.title: Spiritfarer
games.description: The greatest way a video game has told about a very difficult real life topic. Never have I ever cried so much while playing. The saddest game ever and it's not even close. Therefore it holds a special place in my heart. And maybe someday in yours as well.

games.title: Alan Wake 2
games.description: Way more than a horror story. Graphics are closest thing to real life. Not on Steam but if you ever have a chance to experience this. Do your self a favor and watch Alan Wake 1 recap and play this. Sami Järvi is Finnish Kojima.

games.title: Risk of Rain 2
games.description: The most interesting and fun roguelike/roguelite to date. Perfect gameplay and controls combined with the most unique soundtrack I have ever heard. I've every Risk of Rain soundtrack on vinyl. It says a lot.

games.title: Bloodborne
games.description: Bloodborne has the greatest 3rd person combat. Every weapon is masterfully crafted and unique in their own way. Boss fights are some of the genres best (and worst at times lmao). It is CRIMINAL that Sony doesn't do anything with this IP (except the movie).

games.title: Katana ZERO
games.description: A short but very mysterious and unique experience with banger gameplay and aesthetics. Another must play especially if you enjoyed the vibes of Hotline Miami.

games.title: Team Fortress 2
games.description: Just the best hero shooter ever created. And I don't think there will ever be a better one. Every class as so much personality and their gameplay differs from each other in a perfect way. A timeless masterpiece.

games.title: CTR: Crash Team Racing - Nitro-Fueled
games.description: The greatest kart racer there is. And the best Crash Bandicoot game. AND the best remake ever made. “Easy to learn, hard to master” perfected. Shoutout to the CTR community back in 2020-2021.

games.title: Minecraft
games.description: Well it's Minecraft. So many memories and experiences. The game that has been with me the longest. An enviorment where you can basically do anything.

games.title: Slay the Princess
games.description: Philosophical and psychological masterpiece. Just give yourself 3 hours and experience this. Has like every emotion there is.

games.title: In Stars And Time
games.description: Perfectly explained the consequences of time travel. Reminded me why I love indie turn-based RPGs. So much impact in such small package.

games.title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
games.description: The greatest conclusion to a video game series ever. The build up to this game is something else.

games.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
games.description: Not Elden Ring, not Bloodborne but still one of the best soulsborne games. The combat is so unique and satisfying. Hardest game I've ever played. If you beat this enjoy the “Gamer” status hehe.

games.title: Helldivers 2
games.description: The most satisfying co-op experience. So smooth gameplay with unique humor and great gunplay.

games.title: UNBEATABLE
games.description: The game in not for everyone but the message of the story is. By the way, every animation in the trailers is real and in game footage.

games.title: The Messenger
games.description: I don't really like metroidvanias but The Messenger executes the concept perfectly for me. From the same studio that created Sea of Stars therefore this game cannot miss.

games.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages
games.description: The modern DOOM perfected for my liking. Just so satisfying combat. Also the story is interesting.
